summary: Build a foundation in cross-border cash, FX exposure and treasury decisions. Review practical tools and enrol in the five-day course.
lede: Global treasury management coordinates corporate cash, currency exposures and funding choices across borders. For treasury analysts, cash managers and corporate finance professionals, this course provides a practical foundation for assessing cash-flow timing and explaining treasury decisions through exposure mapping, currency forecasting, and comparisons of pooling, netting and hedging options. It also covers investment and counterparty review criteria, plus reconciliation needs in SWIFT and ISO 20022 payment data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate corporate cash, cross-border payments, currency exposures or treasury decisions and need a practical foundation for the work.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with financial statements and foreign-currency transactions is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel available for spreadsheet exercises.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
